rules: preserve source evidence without adjudicating truth
absence is not a negative finding
normalization and learning happen under separate governed stages

commits.message: Research: assemble offline adapter candidate kit and read-only probes
Research: include existing pinned MCP candidates in kit
Research: reject all aliased comparator inputs
Research: prepare generic Desktop chain qualification

pull_request.body:
## Goal

Prepare a reusable, offline **candidate kit** while the target Windows laptop is unavailable. This PR makes no component a new CAP public tool or production dependency.

- `config/adapter-candidate-kit.json`: 18 entries across Files, Browser, Desktop, procedures, Office, local vision, MCP aggregation, devices, sessions and process supervision. Each entry distinguishes current scoped infrastructure from qualified, reserve, blocked and unmerged candidates.
- The kit also includes the two existing pinned free MCP profiles: `runtime/candidates/filesystem-readonly.json` and `runtime/candidates/playwright-headless.json`, already exercised by `scripts/test-module-candidates.ps1`.
- `scripts/adapter-candidate-kit.mjs`: read-only listing, project-anchor check and optional command-on-PATH observation; `--role desktop --plan` gives the first comparison.
- `scripts/probe-winapp-window.mjs`: qualification-only status/inspect of an independently chosen process image, PID and HWND, without outputting document text or delivering any action.
- `scripts/check-desktop-file-effect.mjs`: independent byte comparison for a disposable target and a decoy, usable after either desktop candidate is tested. Rejects a no-op and aliased baselines.
- `MODULE_CATALOG.md`: finite cross-application chain matrix, comparison order and explanation of what the kit does and does not prove.

## Stage Research Brief — NARROW, offline preparation only

**Baseline/problem evidence.** `main` at `24ed938c587c9d3e2288c92bc156ccc476c955f3` already has the six-tool semantic projection, Playwright Browser, pinned filesystem/Playwright MCP qualification profiles, typed Windows and a Case Desk procedure through pinned OpenAdapt WindowsBackend. PR #164 documents that ordinary Chat has no general public Desktop mutation route; its existing Windows procedure is scoped to Case Desk. Core #175 and Native Host #176 are separate unmerged Drafts; Host v1 supervises one bounded noninteractive process and has not been wired into a Windows UI adapter. Building many production app adapters now would imply authority and physical reliability that the present repo has not proven.

**Architecture lineage.** KEEP accepted Browser/Playwright, scoped Windows/UIA/OpenAdapt, project WorkingState, Verification Kernel and Finish Gate. Keep OpenAdapt Flow/Capture in their previously qualified procedure/capture role pending a concrete consumer. Keep 1MCP optional/internal. WinApp UI is the **first generic Desktop comparison candidate** for a finite multi-app matrix, not a replacement for the accepted Windows path without evidence; FlaUI/pywinauto are reserves. UFO is selective Office mechanics, not a second planner. Home Assistant remains future DEFER and CCCC remains blocked for production persistent ChatGPT sessions under PR #151. No prior role is replaced.

**Mechanisms/domains.** A static source inventory and read-only inspection/file comparison are the only new mechanisms. The relevant domains are software provenance, Windows UI Automation identity, and independent effect observation. No persistence, grant, retry, generic executor, installed binary, process lifecycle or public consequence boundary changes; a delivery/crash matrix becomes necessary when a particular adapter is proposed for actual mutation/retry, not for this read-only kit.

**Problem vs solution evidence.** The need for a reusable kit follows from the already fragmented research in #151/#161/#164 and the lack of a Windows target during preparation. The solution is deliberately an index and diagnostic substrate, supported by existing local Windows qualification scripts and the limited read-only upstream commands. It is not evidence that any candidate passes CAP's end-to-end assurance floor.

**Source-code evidence.**
- Microsoft `microsoft/winappCli@8158d14f8940e1a23d972e729e1dcce84de423ef`: `UiStatusCommand.Handler` resolves `-w` then emits PID/HWND; `UiInspectCommand.Handler` walks a UIA tree; `UiJsonContext` uses camelCase JSON; `UiTargetResolver.ResolveAsync` supports exact HWND but auto-selects foreground/largest for ambiguous app-name targeting; `UiSetValueCommand.Handler` re-resolves the element. `WinApp.UIAutomation.Tests` explicit-target/identity cases were inspected in PR #164. OPEN_IMPLEMENTED, REUSE_COMPONENT candidate; exact installed CLI/version and representative application control trees remain unproven.
- `Tencent/BrowserSkill@75e2c64abaf4b7cc75682d94b0c1fd5db0cbd5e5`: `crates/bsk-cli/src/daemon/ws.rs::origin_allowed` accepts any extension-shaped Origin. The same method at upstream `ext-v0.3.1` still has the broad check. PR #161 traces the browser action/session path and resulting logged-in-profile authority gap. OPEN_IMPLEMENTED, research-only reuse candidate.
- CAP pinned `OpenAdaptAI/openadapt-flow@d7f58d9f35c8369f16a9b378f23952d425334ad7`: `windows_case_update.py` actually instantiates `WindowsBackend` and a hardened loopback `win_agent` with legacy exec disabled; Stage 26 research and qualification own its observed physical scope. OPEN_IMPLEMENTED locally for Case Desk, not a general public Desktop route.

**Alternatives.** Bulk import of skills/MCP catalogs would expose unmanaged consequence authority. Rebuilding Windows/browser/capture mechanics duplicates accepted or credible upstream work. Selected path: retain existing providers, pin/track free alternatives by role, add only read-only discovery and independent byte comparison until one concrete use case can be compared on Windows.

**Failure lessons.** WinApp app-name matching can select a different window; probe requires independently supplied process image, PID + HWND and checks both. UIA `set-value` is unsupported by some rich editors, so no text action is chosen before inspecting the real application's control tree. BrowserSkill local peer authentication remains unresolved for user-profile production authority. Delivery receipts or file-byte equality do not prove CAP authorization, window identity or whole-task completion.

**Verification/acceptance.** Node syntax and manifest checks pass; on Linux the WinApp UI probe fails before trying to interact. Synthetic byte fixtures show the comparator accepts the intended changed file/untouched decoy and refuses an altered decoy or a no-op. Future Windows work starts from the accepted Case Desk regression, then runs short observe/act/verify chains across a finite Win32, Electron, document and dialog matrix. File effects use fresh disposable targets/decoys; non-file effects require independent application-state evidence. Source/install attestations, exact targets, focus/dialog variants, CAP authorization/verification, review and physical evidence remain required before any general public Desktop consequence route is proposed as accepted.

**Complexity budget.** One manifest, three qualification-only scripts and one section in the existing Module Catalog. No new runtime interface, registry, provider framework, public tool or default dependency.

## Current limits

All executable checks here are read-only. `--check` proves only manifest validity and local anchor presence; `PATH` detection is not installed-binary attestation. No Windows physical run, independent code review, Core/Host integration or CAP public-route expansion is claimed. Keep this PR Draft until its intended research-only scope is reviewed independently and the existing roadmap prerequisites are respected.
